explication: ccstatusline is a configurable status-line formatter and terminal configuration UI for Claude Code. Claude Code supplies status input to the CLI, which gathers transcript and environment metrics, renders configured widgets, and writes the formatted line. Users configure layouts and integrations in the Ink TUI, preview changes, and save or install the status-line command. The README documents broad widget families and import/export capabilities; sampled excerpts confirm the CLI/TUI rendering and configuration flows, but do not expose every widget’s data wiring.
